rationale: The eventual delivery-path candidate is structured_delivery because the change introduces product semantics and runtime behavior across hosts, spans six canonical owners and eight source/derived paths, and lacks deterministic propagation. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced; Verified Change is also ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Canonical owner count is 6, so the change is cross-owner.
Source path count is 8 and derived path count is 8.
Completed Brownfield analysis is not evidenced.
Stored quick_task context is not evidenced.
This is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate, not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
